reasons.correctness: SupportTicketCreatedEvent matches the interface with all six getters. The listener uses AFTER_COMMIT. createTicket publishes via ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. Build green; hidden tests 3/3.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener in support/ticket/event uses @RequiredArgsConstructor and @TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT), and catches and logs its failure. The publisher is added through the existing explicit constructor, with no field injection.
reasons.design_fit: Follows the existing InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern and adds no parallel mechanism. EmailService stays in the service because addAdminResponse still uses it. Minimal footprint.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send with exact arguments and the swallowed SMTP failure. The service unit test captures the event fields and verifies no EmailService call. Mockito only, no Spring context. The integration test assertion was updated, not deleted.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries mapped the support/ticket package, the existing *EventListener/*Event exemplars, the service's dependents and its TESTED_BY tests before any edit. The agent then read the exemplars the graph surfaced.
